name: ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.Invariant
type: {α : Type u} → {mα : MeasurableSpace α} → ProbabilityTheory.Kernel α α → MeasureTheory.Measure α → Prop
provides: The input measure is unchanged by one kernel step, expressed as equality of its kernel pushforward with itself; probability, uniqueness and mixing are separate properties.
type_review: Definition and composition-invariance consequences inspected with measurable-space parameters; manually expanded, not compiled.
